text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Collecting the math worksheets...?

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The class rep is absent today, so... 
I'm sorry, but could I ask you to fill in 
instead?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Um, well... ...Y-Yes...

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Great! In that case, could you bring it to 
the staff room before the end of the day?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Collect them... Collect from 
everyone... huh."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
C-Could you hand in... your math 
worksheet...?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, of course! You're the one gathering 
them today, Cheval-chan! Hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Um... about that... T-The math... 
worksheet...

text_block_list.name: Pompadour Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aah?! What is it?! Speak up, I can't hear 
you!!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Eek...!! I-I'm sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(S-S-So scary! If I-I look away, I'm gonna 
get eaten, aren't I...!?)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
P-Please hand in... y-your math 
worksheet...!

text_block_list.name: Pompadour Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The math worksheet?! —I totally did it! 
I'm pulling it out right now, just wait!

text_block_list.name: Pompadour Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for gathering the handouts! Good 
work! Here, I'll share some snacks with 
ya! They're super good!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (...She was surprisingly nice...)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...A-All right. Next, that line over—

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Cheval-san, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "Wah!? ...D-Dia-san... what's wrong?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You've been calling out to everyone one by 
one for a while now, but wouldn't it be 
faster to make a general announcement to 
the whole crowd?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...That's true, but... ...Look, just a 
little while ago—

text_block_list.name: Class Representative Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, handouts collection is closing! 
Anyone haven't turned theirs in yet?

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "U-Um... ...I forgot to do it..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I think it's embarrassing to say you 
forgot something in front of everyone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Still, I thought that might not happen if 
we collect them one by one...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. You really are kind, Cheval-san.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? ...N-No no no! It's not like that at 
all...!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
No, please don't be so modest. I think 
that's a truly wonderful way of thinking!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
"Such thoughtful consideration, just like 
you... I must learn from your example!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Ugh... r-really, it's not that big of 
a deal, though..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As I was walking down the hallway, I 
spotted Cheval Grand looking somewhat in 
high spirits.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Y-Yes. I managed to do the job I was 
assigned properly...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
All I did was collect the handouts for 
class, but... I'm just, happy I was able 
to do it, I guess...
choice_data_list: So you managed to breeze through the work?

You gathered enough for everyone. Good 
job.

You gathered enough for everyone. Good 
job.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
All I did was collect the handouts for 
class, but... I'm just, happy I was able 
to do it, I guess...
choice_data_list: So you managed to breeze through the work?

You gathered enough for everyone. Good 
job.

You gathered enough for everyone. Good 
job.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No! ...That's not true. I was just 
nervous talking to everyone...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Still, thanks to that, I was able to 
get a little closer with girls other than 
Kita-san and Dia-san, too...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no...! Th-They might not think 
anything of me at all, though...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
It's just, um... I-I think there are a lot 
of kind girls in our class...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......Um, yes. Enough for everyone in 
class... Ah!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I haven't turned mine in yet...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I'm sorry, Trainer! I'll bring it right 
out!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
*whew*... I'm so glad I submitted it in 
time...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: "...'Impressive', huh? ...Hehe."
